h1: Chumphon Palace Hotel — A City Hotel Just 300 m from Chumphon Railway Station
intro: If you arrive in Chumphon by train and want somewhere you can wheel your bag straight to without flagging a ride, Chumphon Palace Hotel makes sense — a city hotel about 300 m from the railway station, with the market and night plaza just a few minutes' walk away. It's an older building that's been renovated; what guests mention most are clean rooms, friendly staff, and a very easy price. Around 72 rooms, from approx. ฿450/night · 8.9 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Chumphon Palace Hotel is a straightforward city hotel that trades mainly on location and value. The building has been around a while and went through a major renovation around 2015. It has roughly 72 rooms, most of them standard units of 20–22 square metres with twin or double beds. It isn't fancy, but it's well set up for a night's sleep before catching a ferry to Koh Tao or Koh Phangan, or continuing your journey by train.

What guests agree on most is the cleanliness and the staff. Many note that, old building aside, the rooms are kept clean, the beds are comfortable, and the front-desk team is friendly and helpful — with ferry tickets, bus tickets, and tips on nearby places to eat. Add in rates that start at just a few hundred baht, and most people conclude they got rather more than they paid for.
"Old hotel but really clean, lovely staff who sorted our ferry tickets to Koh Tao, and it's only a few minutes' walk from the train station. At this price, brilliant value."

Location is the real trump card here. It's about 300 m on foot from Chumphon Railway Station, and roughly a 10-minute walk to the fresh market and night plaza — which means dinner is easy, from curry-and-rice to made-to-order dishes and street snacks. There's a convenience store close by, and free parking for anyone driving. For travellers using Chumphon as a ferry stopover, this kind of location saves both time and taxi fares.

What you'll need to accept is the age of the building and the air conditioning. Some rooms have older built-in AC units that a few guests felt didn't cool enough on really hot days. The décor is plain with nothing in the way of design, and there's no pool or gym. Breakfast information is inconsistent across platforms too — some say a simple one is included, others say none — so check with the hotel at booking if it matters to you.

For onward travel, this suits people who arrive by train or coach and want to sleep near the connection. The piers for Koh Tao and Koh Phangan (around Pak Nam Chumphon) are roughly a 20–25 minute drive away, and the hotel can help arrange a transfer or recommend a minivan. Chumphon's nicer beaches, Sai Ri and Thung Wua Laen, are further out and better suited to travellers with a car.

Honestly, Chumphon Palace Hotel isn't for anyone after a resort feel or a sea view, but if the goal is a clean bed, an easy price, and a central spot within walking distance of the station and market, it does that job well at a price that's hard to find in town. It's an ideal one-night base before a ferry to the islands or an onward trip. If you want new rooms, ice-cold AC, or full facilities like a pool, you may prefer another option in the roundup.

faq.q: Where is Chumphon Palace Hotel, and how close is the railway station?
faq.a: It's at 328/15 Pracha Uthit Road, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon, right in the city centre · just about 300 m (a 4-minute walk) from Chumphon Railway Station, and roughly a 10-minute walk from the market and night plaza. It's ideal if you arrive by train.

faq.q: How much does Chumphon Palace Hotel cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approx. ฿450/night for a Standard Twin of 20–22 sqm · there are also double rooms, renovated Superior rooms, and family rooms (about ฿650–฿850). Prices vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before you book.

faq.q: Who is Chumphon Palace Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers arriving by train or coach who want a clean, affordable, central place to sleep — a tidy one-night base before a ferry to Koh Tao or Koh Phangan. If you want a beachfront resort or modern new rooms, another option may suit you better.

faq.q: Does Chumphon Palace Hotel have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: There is free parking for anyone driving. Breakfast info is inconsistent across platforms — some say a simple one is included, others say none — so confirm with the hotel at booking, or just walk to the nearby market to eat.

faq.q: How do I get from Chumphon Palace Hotel to the Koh Tao ferry?
faq.a: The piers for Koh Tao and Koh Phangan are around Pak Nam Chumphon, roughly a 25-minute drive away · hotel staff can help arrange ferry tickets and transport to the pier · flag it at check-in so they can time it for the ferry you want.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Chumphon Palace Hotel?
faq.a: Most rooms are standard 20–22 sqm units with AC, TV and a fridge · the praised points are cleanliness and comfortable beds, even though the building is old · note that some rooms have older AC that may not cool enough on very hot days — ask for a renovated room if you want better condition.
